Our Mission

Pillars of Our Community

We are committed to nurturing faith, fostering unity, and serving humanity — rooted in the teachings of Islam.

📖
Jamia Mujadidia Lasania

A distinguished institute of Islamic learning offering Quranic studies, Arabic language programs, and traditional religious education for all ages — from children to adults seeking deeper knowledge.

🕌
Khatam e Nabuwat Wing

Dedicated to upholding and spreading the sacred belief in the finality of Prophethood of our beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

🤝
Community Service

Food drives, social outreach, counseling, and support programs for families and individuals in need throughout the city.

🌙
Youth Programs

Empowering the next generation through mentorship, leadership workshops, sports leagues, and faith-centered activities.
